content: The file /tmp/mte-ed-refund-log-2yqkjjiu/ledgerline/src/billing/refunds.py has been updated successfully. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)

I added a log line at the top of `refund()` in `src/billing/refunds.py`. It logs `refund_requested` with the invoice id. I haven't run the code or any tests.

The project's stored decision is to use structlog, not stdlib `logging`, with snake_case event keys. So I added `import structlog` and `log = structlog.get_logger()` at module level and wrote `log.info("refund_requested", invoice_id=invoice.id)`.

The log fires before the amount check, so a refund that raises "refund exceeds invoice total" still gets logged. If you'd rather log only valid refunds, I can move it after the check.

No new durable knowledge came up, so I didn't save any memories.
